root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from the `l2cap_le_connect_req` function in the Bluetooth L2CAP subsystem failing to verify encryption key size requirements when processing incoming LE connection requests.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a conditional check using `l2cap_check_enc_key_size` within `l2cap_le_connect_req` in `net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c`, and the CVE description specifies this validation is required by the L2CAP/LE/CFC/BV-15-C specification to return `L2CAP_CR_LE_BAD_KEY_SIZE`.
